recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work about a distinct physical manufacturer should follow the separate manufacturer-extension path rather than changing Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder.
issue_request: FHIR-27030 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Medication. It requested changing the confusing Medication and MedicationKnowledge manufacturer element to sponsor and updating the definition to describe the organization responsible for manufacturing or registration to market the product in a jurisdiction, including Market Authorization Holder as an example.
initial_application: Commit 1683ac64141af807564d62a28932d70133142fb3 applied the issue by renaming Medication.manufacturer and MedicationKnowledge.manufacturer to sponsor, updating the related search parameters, and changing Medication examples from manufacturer to sponsor.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-32759 changed Medication.sponsor to Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder after Pharmacy/BR&R discussion and is already represented on the combined branch. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-35858 corrected the MAH definition because the prior wording still described manufacturer. MedicationKnowledge.sponsor was removed during later MedicationKnowledge definitional-element restructuring, and MedicationKnowledge is not listed as an active resource in the current source/fhir.ini [resources] section. The originating Immunization issue FHIR-27027 was later resolved no-change by Public Health.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope Medication source defines Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder and the matching marketingauthorizationholder search parameter, while source/fhir.ini maps old Medication.manufacturer to Medication.marketingAuthorizationHolder for R4-to-R6 changes. Restoring sponsor or manufacturer-centered wording would conflict with later Pharmacy decisions.
